items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: I have a brother, twenty years younger than me, Ricky, and he’s a drummer also.

ctx.x: Oh, that’s nice. © Fillius Jazz Archive -21-

I mean this woman was just too much. I mean I would come home, even early there, I’d come home and practice. And I was really gone. Once I got into it I mean I was a maniac, I’d practice all the time. And she was just totally into it. And I’ll never forget one night we were at Birdland. I forget who I was with, oh probably with Toshiko. And we were opening for Buddy Rich’s band. And so we were up there and I played and everything and I says, “Mom, we’re going to sit and listen to Buddy Rich.” So we were watching…
Right. Well it’s nice to have that on your side, isn’t it.
